cases.title: First lesson: asks what should snap before proposing; candidates as questions, at most three; real names

rubric.reason: Before naming any candidate or setting a focus, the mentor asks "Is anything here meant to snap, like a blink, an on/off, or a cut?" and only gives one line of framing first.

It names two candidates by layer and property, Blink Opacity and Cut Opacity, each framed as a question ("Is it meant to blink on and off sharply, or fade?"), never as a mistake or an instruction to hold.
"Two weeks ago you eased the Title in Mentor Practice" matches the record's 2026-10-12 easing lesson in plain words with an accurate how-long-ago, without reading out fields.
Mentor Practice 2, Blink Opacity (three pairs, first at 1 s) and Cut Opacity (one pair at 3 s) all match key_types_snapshot, and Title and Mentor Practice come from the learner record.
